title: Adaptive Query Execution: the runtime re-optimization loop
purpose: Adaptive Query Execution loop. Static plan from estimates; Execute materializable stages; Collect real statistics; Coalesce partitions; Convert joins to broadcast; Split skewed partitions.
accessibleSummary: Adaptive Query Execution loop. Static plan from estimates; Execute materializable stages; Collect real statistics; Coalesce partitions; Convert joins to broadcast; Split skewed partitions.
longDescription: Adaptive Query Execution loop. Static plan from estimates; Execute materializable stages; Collect real statistics; Coalesce partitions; Convert joins to broadcast; Split skewed partitions.

nodes.label: Static plan built from estimates
nodes.summary: Catalyst commits to a plan using pre-execution estimates that may be badly wrong.
nodes.detail: Catalyst commits to a plan using pre-execution estimates that may be badly wrong.
nodes.whyItMatters: Catalyst commits to a plan using pre-execution estimates that may be badly wrong.

evidence.note: Catalyst plans from pre-execution statistics; AQE exists to correct that plan at runtime.

processing: Choose join strategy and partition count up front
drill.example: A join is planned as sort-merge because the optimizer cannot measure how selective an upstream filter is.
failureModes: A wrong estimate commits the query to two sorts and two shuffles it did not need.

nodes.label: Execute materializable stages
nodes.summary: AQE runs the stages it can and pauses at the shuffle boundary.
nodes.detail: AQE runs the stages it can and pauses at the shuffle boundary.
nodes.whyItMatters: AQE runs the stages it can and pauses at the shuffle boundary.

evidence.note: AQE uses runtime statistics from completed stages to choose the most efficient plan.

processing: Run stages that can be materialized
outputs: Completed stage output and its statistics
drill.example: The scan and map side complete while the join strategy for the next stage remains undecided.
failureModes: With AQE disabled the whole plan is fixed in advance and no correction is possible.

nodes.label: Collect real shuffle statistics
nodes.summary: Real partition sizes from completed stages replace the original estimates.
nodes.detail: Real partition sizes from completed stages replace the original estimates.
nodes.whyItMatters: Real partition sizes from completed stages replace the original estimates.

evidence.note: AQE re-runs the optimizer and physical planner using measured shuffle statistics.

inputs: Shuffle output sizes and row counts
processing: Re-run optimizer and physical planner over the remaining plan
outputs: Revised plan for the remaining stages
drill.example: A side estimated at 400 MB measures 6 MB after filtering, changing the join decision.
failureModes: Statistics only exist past an exchange, so an all-narrow query is never revisited.

nodes.label: Coalesce post-shuffle partitions
nodes.summary: Undersized post-shuffle partitions merge toward the advisory target size.
nodes.detail: Undersized post-shuffle partitions merge toward the advisory target size.
nodes.whyItMatters: Undersized post-shuffle partitions merge toward the advisory target size.

evidence.note: coalescePartitions merges small post-shuffle partitions toward advisoryPartitionSizeInBytes, default 64 MB.
shuffle.partitions defaults to 200 and acts as an upper bound when coalescing is on.

drill.example: 200 planned partitions averaging 8 MB coalesce into roughly 25 partitions near the target.
failureModes: Thousands of sub-second tasks indicate coalescing is off or the target is far too small.

nodes.label: Convert sort-merge to broadcast
nodes.summary: A sort-merge join converts to broadcast when measured sizes justify it.
nodes.detail: A sort-merge join converts to broadcast when measured sizes justify it.
nodes.whyItMatters: A sort-merge join converts to broadcast when measured sizes justify it.

evidence.note: AQE converts sort-merge join to broadcast hash join when runtime statistics show a side is small enough.

inputs: Measured size of each join side
processing: Compare against the adaptive broadcast threshold
outputs: Broadcast hash join instead of sort-merge
drill.example: A dimension that filters down to 6 MB is broadcast, removing both shuffles and both sorts.
failureModes: A broadcast forced by an explicit hint bypasses this runtime safety check entirely.

nodes.label: Split skewed partitions
nodes.summary: Oversized partitions are split and the matching side replicated.
nodes.detail: Oversized partitions are split and the matching side replicated.
nodes.whyItMatters: Oversized partitions are split and the matching side replicated.

evidence.note: skewJoin splits partitions exceeding skewedPartitionFactor 5.0 times the median and 256 MB, replicating the matching side.

processing: Split and replicate the matching side
drill.example: One 4 GB partition among 200 averaging 50 MB is split into sub-partitions instead of becoming a straggler.
failureModes: Aggregation skew is not covered by skew-join handling and still requires salting.

nodes.label: AQE needs a shuffle to act on
nodes.summary: AQE only engages where a shuffle exists, and does not fix aggregation skew.
nodes.detail: AQE only engages where a shuffle exists, and does not fix aggregation skew.
nodes.whyItMatters: AQE only engages where a shuffle exists, and does not fix aggregation skew.

evidence.note: AQE depends on runtime statistics produced at shuffle boundaries.

processing: Check for an exchange to re-optimize around
outputs: Either an adaptive plan or an unchanged static one
drill.example: A filter-and-write job with no join or groupBy runs entirely on the original plan.
failureModes: Expecting AQE to fix a narrow-only query wastes time that belongs in the table layout.

nodes.label: Hard-coded settings defeat it
nodes.summary: Hard-coded partition counts override the runtime measurement AQE performs.
nodes.detail: Hard-coded partition counts override the runtime measurement AQE performs.
nodes.whyItMatters: Hard-coded partition counts override the runtime measurement AQE performs.

evidence.note: The common failure mode is a team pasting settings into every notebook and defeating AQE's runtime measurements.

inputs: Copied configuration or a hard-coded repartition
outputs: A plan pinned to a guess
drill.example: repartition(400) forces a partition count regardless of what the data actually measured.
controls: Remove the override and let AQE measure
failureModes: Tuning appears to do nothing because the pinned value replaces the adaptive one.

edges.label: Plan is provisional past the first exchange
Small partitions merged toward the target
No exchange means nothing to re-optimize
